Fixed validation preserves exactly the public25 map paths and identities, spawn/fault seeds,N,budget and max_rounds. Older server paths were absolute; paths are compared relative to its project root.
Initial run.json retains failed status for the original artifact-binding test. Overall status is based on final per-test outcomes and the unchanged successful dataset audit.
